info.title: AbiZeitBetrug Portal API
info.description: Private LMGU 2027 editorial portal. External OIDC login establishes a server-side cookie session; JWTs stay on the backend. CSRF-protected mutations and all authorization enforced server-side. Authentication redirects and provider endpoints are outside this API.

get.summary: List collections (students: no drafts; ballot_count and participation editors only)

post.summary: Create collection (admins; managers for single-answer kinds only)

patch.summary: Update collection (admin for repeatable kinds; editors with grant for single-answer drafts); kind changes stay within their group
Edit own pending contribution with optimistic concurrency; editorial roles cannot change another author’s original

post.summary: Attach image to own pending contribution; original content stays author-owned

delete.summary: Remove attachment from own pending contribution

post.summary: Add editorial annotation with category grant (any status), or author correction request on locked contribution

get.summary: Export all collected contributions by default, with optional explicit status filter (editors, repeatable only)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Defaults to all statuses; explicit status filtering remains available for later moderation.

post.summary: Open or close a single-answer category (400 for repeatable)

put.summary: Cast or replace a named ballot with up to max_choices distinct options

repeatable.description: True for idea, quote, memory, photo (any number of submissions); false for person, proposal (single-answer ballot).

my_option_id.description: First current selection in canonical ID order (legacy compatibility), or null.

opened_at.description: Set once when a single-answer category moves from draft to open; creation time for repeatable ones.

ballot_count.description: Number of distinct current voters. Editors only; null for students and repeatable categories.

participation.description: Current voting participation among admitted cohort members, regardless of role. Both counts use the same population and database snapshot. Editors only; null for students and repeatable categories. Preserved ballots from people no longer eligible are excluded here but remain in ballot_count.

voted.description: Currently eligible people with a current ballot in this collection.

all_people.description: Person polls only: all admitted cohort members, refreshed when opening and fixed thereafter. Existing polls retain explicit candidates.

max_choices.description: Maximum selections per voter; 1 for proposal and repeatable categories.

my_option_ids.description: Viewer’s complete current selection; empty for repeatable categories or before voting.

ballot_id.description: Groups the complete selection from one ballot change. Null for legacy single-choice history.

options.description: Empty for repeatable kinds and all_people person polls; otherwise 2–500 unique options. Person options must reference admitted cohort members.

all_people.description: Person polls: all admitted cohort members instead of explicit options. Defaults true on creation; omission preserves mode on edit. Other kinds require false.

max_choices.description: Maximum selections for person polls; other kinds require 1.
